function.description: Spot price for ONE token contract address (not a ticker).
function.name: defi_data_price

address.description: The TOKEN's address: on EVM chains its contract (0x…, 40 hex); on solana its MINT (base58). A ticker is not accepted — use token_resolve first. A WALLET is not a token: to see what a wallet holds use wallet_holdings.

chain.description: Chain to look the token up on — the same address is a DIFFERENT token on a different chain, so name it deliberately. Readable: ethereum, base, robinhood, robinhood-testnet, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, solana.
